name: Koi Ninja Sengoku Emaki
source:
An era of turmoil. Nobunaga Oda was trying to conquer the world, and to wipe out all "Ninjas". Iga, Koga and Fuma have joined forces in order to fight Nobunaga.

I had been living as the granddaughter of a chief priest at a temple without knowing anything, when, one day, a group of ninjas suddenly appeared in front of me. I hastened back to the temple to ask my grandfather if he knew what was going on, only to find him in deep conversation with a guest. 

"Nobunaga is trying to wipe out Iga, Koga, Fuma... and all of the ninjas there."
"I know, Lord Hattori. We have to stop Nobunaga or the future of the ninjas is doomed."

Iga, Koga, Fuma, Hattori... the future of ninjas? What's going on!? My grandfather noticed me and told me that I am the princess who succeeds to the art of Ninjutsu and as the symbol of the pact among Iga, Koga and Fuma. What!? All of a sudden, the whole place was packed with ninjas. I have to go Iga where the allied ninja are gathering with only one of strong ninjas. Are you serious!? What’s going to become of me?

[From [url=http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/shall-we-date-ninja-love/id453184001?mt=8]iTunes Store[/url]]
translation:
群雄割据的战国时代。织田信长意图统一天下，并将所有“忍者”赶尽杀绝。伊贺、甲贺与风魔为对抗信长结成同盟。

我一直以寺院住持孙女的身份生活，对此一无所知。某天，一群忍者突然出现在我面前。我赶忙回寺院询问祖父，却见他正与一名客人低声商议。

“信长企图消灭伊贺、甲贺、风魔……把那里的忍者统统斩尽杀绝。”
“我知道，服部大人。我们必须阻止信长，否则忍者便没有未来。”

伊贺、甲贺、风魔、服部……忍者的未来？这究竟是怎么回事？祖父发现我后，告诉我，我是继承忍术的公主，也是伊贺、甲贺、风魔三方盟约的象征。什么？转眼间，整座寺院都挤满了忍者。我必须只带一名强大的忍者，前往同盟军集结的伊贺。这不是开玩笑吧？我今后到底会怎样？

[引自[url=http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/shall-we-date-ninja-love/id453184001?mt=8]iTunes Store[/url]]
